name: Kadhi
description: Sour yogurt thickened with besan and simmered slowly with tempering.

tcm.note: Yogurt-based and eaten warm; cooling overall.

ayurveda.note: Soured dahi is firmly ushna — the classical reading, whatever the dish feels like.

unani.note: Thanda-tar in desi usage; the hing and methi tempering is there to make it digestible.

histamine.note: Deliberately soured yogurt, simmered long — high, and worth knowing on a reactive day.
